  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "store.Get returns a deleted reminder with a nil error, so owned() dereferences nil"
                 body: "Group fp_4828a6, reports cr_1e2ea0 (2 crashes) and cr_ee551c, all in v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a).\n\nPanic: nil pointer dereference in api.(*API).owned (api/reminders.go:144, rem.UserID).\n\nCause: store.Get (store/store.go, Get) handles a deleted reminder with `r = nil` but leaves err nil. Its doc says deleted reminders are not returned, yet callers get (nil, nil). owned() checks err, sees none, and reads rem.UserID.\n\nEvidence: the logs show rem_0001 deleted at 14:11:02 (DELETE, 204), then POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done at 14:12, which crashed.\n\nFix: in Get, set err = ErrNotFound in the deleted case. Other callers (api/lists.go, api/search.go) already skip on error. addListReminder (api/lists.go:113) also checks err.\n\nReproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go, TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound. It fails on the old code and passes with the fix. The full suite passes."
                 fingerprint: "fp_4828a6"
                 reproducer: {"file":"store/get_deleted_test.go","function":"TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound"}
  tool result: filed #103

A header of exactly \"Bearer\" (no token) gives one element, so [1] panics. Fix: require the \"Bearer \" prefix, split, and check that a token is present. I could not apply it: the auth/ directory is protected, and writing auth/parse_bearer_test.go was denied. This needs a person with access to auth/. Suggested test: parseBearer(\"Bearer\") returns (\"\", false) without panicking."
